boundary.description: From the junction of Church Road and Captain’s Clough Road, S along Captain’s Clough Road, E through Captain’s Clough to Ivy Road, near its junction with Cunliffe Brow. S along Ivy Road, then E along Chorley Old Road to its junction with Shepherd Cross Street and by a bee-line SW to and along Victory Street, Beverly Road, Dobson Road. Then E along Gilnow Road and S by a bee-line to the railway including both sides of Gilnow Gardens in St Thomas of Canterbury parish. E along the railway, past Lostock station and by a bee-line to the footpath leading to Regent Road (including all of Overdene and Morris Fold Drive estate). Then N along Regent Road, W along Chorley New Road, and by a bee-line to Chorley Old Road (including both sides of Princess Road and the Kilphin). E along Chorley Old Road, Old Kiln Lane, Moss Bank Way, Chorley Old Road, New Church Road and Church Road to its junction with Captain’s Clough Road.
